what_it_shows: Cell Phones department: Unlocked, Apple iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel, Motorola, Android, refurbished, with plans, prepaid, SIM cards, kids and senior phones; browse by type and by carrier; accessories (chargers, power banks, cases) are a separate sibling

E-book readers are their own category, filtered by screen size (under 6, 6 to 7, 7 plus inches), built-in light, waterproofing, network type, panel type (Carta, Kaleido), storage; sits next to tablet PC and tablet cases in related categories

Guide separates Tablets, E-readers and Digital Pads (drawing/input tablets) as three device types; tablets by screen-size bands (under 7, 7.1-9, 9.1-11, over 11 in); E-readers by screen type (E-ink, Kaleido colour), library, audiobooks

Phone finder facets: brand, year, availability, price, network, form factor (bar, flip up, flip down, slide, swivel, watch, other, foldable), QWERTY, IP rating, back/frame material, OS (feature phones, Android, iOS, KaiOS...); tablets via a mode switch

Phone form factors: bar (incl. keyboard bar, brick, slate, phablet, multi-screen, taco), movable-section forms (clamshell/flip, foldable, slider, swivel, mixed), wearables (smartwatch); phablet defined by screen over 5.3 in
Smartphone range = price-based segmentation: budget under 200 USD, mid-range 300-500, premium over 800; foldables a premium subcategory; update-support length and satellite SOS vary by tier
Wearable Technology department: Smartwatches, Smart Rings, Fitness Trackers, Smart Glasses, then accessories (bands, chargers, screen protectors, ring accessories); wristwatches a related category

Garmin wearables facets: case size (small, medium, large), battery life bands, built-in GPS, display type (AMOLED, MicroLED, hidden, screenless), connectivity (BT calls, cellular, cellular and satellite), series (fenix, Instinct, Venu, vivoactive, vivosmart, Forerunner); activity sub-lines (running, multisport, golf, diving, kids, hybrid, luxury)

Handheld GPS divided by a maker-assigned level (Entry, Advanced, Premium) plus display size, battery type (rechargeable or AA), connectivity (2-way radio, inReach satellite); lines eTrex, GPSMAP 65, Rino
Satellite communicators (inReach) are a separate outdoor-recreation category next to handhelds, adventure watches and service plans; plans are a subscription outside the device
